subject: Post-call: BlueWave on‑prem footprint, support bands & $/1M tokens target
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Saira Khan <saira@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: BlueWave on‑prem footprint, support bands & $/1M tokens target

Saira — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned.

Call highlights (short):
- BlueWave is evaluating a private/on‑prem deployment for inference (regulated finance workloads).
- Target monthly token volume: 120M–180M tokens to start, spiking to ~400M for seasonal runs.
- Budget band: initial OPEX+license target of ~$15k–$25k/month (approx), with willingness to commit to a 12–18 month contract for better unit economics.
- Key requirements: 2 production envs (prod + staging), 1 shared dev environment, KMS integration, SOC2 evidence, 24x7 premium support for production.

Redwood initial commercial thinking (high level):
- Licensing model: annual/private deployment fee + per‑environment operational adders OR an alternative flat committed tokens/yr model (we should price both).
- Unit economics target: client asked for an anchor of $X per 1M tokens — we proposed hitting ~ $1,200–$1,600 / 1M tokens with a committed plan; need to confirm if that aligns with BlueWave's expectations.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours) vs Premium (24x7 + SLA) — Premium recommended for finance production workloads.

Action items (owners & timing):
1) Jonas: send a concise price sketch (3 options: per-env + support, committed tokens + discount, hybrid) by EOD Tue (2027-06-15). Attachment: redwood-proposal-v1.pdf (sketch).
2) Saira: confirm whether BlueWave prefers per-env licensing or committed token model by Wed (2027-06-16).
3) Marissa: if BlueWave leans committed tokens, run a unit-econ calc for 120–400M tokens and include sensitivity to quantization and batching by Fri (2027-06-18).
4) Marcus: prepare a support SLA note (what Premium includes, incident response times) and estimated uplift % to license by Fri (2027-06-18).

Open questions for BlueWave:
- Do you have an internal runbook for peak windows (when spikes happen) and whether you can accept queued bursts?
- Are there any procurement constraints (PO, net-60, or must be prepaid)?

Please reply with any corrections. If this matches your notes, we'll follow the action list.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: BlueWave_requirements_v1.pdf (pdf) — your redacted requirements doc from the call.

From: Saira Khan <saira@bluewave.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, procurement@bluewave.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: BlueWave on‑prem footprint, support bands & $/1M tokens target

Thanks Jonas — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Token volumes: 120M–180M is our steady state. The 400M spike is a quarterly batch that runs for 48–72 hours; we need predictable handling for those spikes (prefer auto-burst into extra capacity rather than queuing).
2) Budget: our procurement lead indicated a target of ~$18k–$22k/month for the first year; we can stretch to $25k/month if the SLA and audit evidence are strong.
3) Licensing preference: we lean toward per-environment licensing with a consumption overlay — simpler for our internal chargeback teams. That said, we're open to seeing committed token pricing if the math is compelling.
4) Support: must include 24x7 phone escalation for P1, and a dedicated TAM is preferred.

Procurement note: we require a standard Master Services Agreement (MSA) and prefer Net‑30 billing. Will need a SOC2 attestation and data-processing addendum (DPA) in the contract.

Next: please send the three commercial sketches. If you can include a worked example showing the approximate $/1M tokens under each option (with the 120M and 400M profiles), that will help procurement.

—Saira
Saira Khan
Head of Infrastructure | BlueWave AI
saira@bluewave.ai

Saira — thanks for the clarifications, very helpful. Attaching a short sketch (redwood-proposal-v1.pdf) with the three options and worked examples for 120M and 400M token months. High level summary below: 

Option A — Per-env licensing + usage overlay
- Annual private deployment fee: $60k/yr (covers infra & private control plane).
- Per env adder: $6k/mo for each production environment (prod, staging) — dev shared env $1.8k/mo. (Total env adders = $13.8k/mo)
- Usage overlay: $2,400 / 1M tokens at on‑demand; committed tiers reduce to $1,400–$1,800 / 1M depending on term/commit.

Example math (approx):
- 120M/mo steady: with a 12‑month commit at $1,400/1M = $168k/yr usage + env adders = ~$165k/yr license+env -> ~ $14k/mo effective (before support uplift).
- 400M spike month: if consumed on top of commit, marginal rates apply — we show two profiles in the PDF.

Option B — Committed token bucket (annual)
- Commit 1.5B tokens/yr (~125M/mo steady) at $1,200 / 1M tokens -> $1.8M/yr -> effective $150k/mo; includes base private deployment fee and 2 prod envs.
- Spikes billed at an overage rate or short-term burst pool at $1,800/1M.

Option C — Hybrid (env fee + smaller commit)
- Smaller annual commit (600M/yr) + per-env fee + lower on-commit unit price.

Support uplift: Premium 24x7 + TAM adds ~18–22% uplift to license/usage depending on exact SLA.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa: please validate the unit-econ rows for committed vs on-demand (120M and 400M scenarios) and add sensitivity to quantization (8-bit vs 4-bit) and batching that could materially reduce $/1M.
- Marcus: prepare the SLA draft and TAM scope; include expected response times and escalation contacts.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a procurement + legal sync later this week.

Thanks — Jonas

Saira — looping back with the unit‑econ sketch I promised (summary below). I'll upload the model and a sensitivity tab to the Google doc (link above) by EOD.

Worked examples (rounded):
- Scenario 1 (120M/mo steady, 12‑month commit):
  - Committed pricing: $1,200 / 1M tokens -> usage = $144k/yr -> ~$12k/mo. + env adders/license amortization = ~$26k/mo total. With Premium support (~20% uplift) -> ~$31k/mo.
- Scenario 2 (steady 120M, but contract with lower commit and higher overage):
  - Hybrid ends up ~ $28k–$34k/mo depending on commit size and amortization of deployment fee.
- Scenario 3 (400M spike month):
  - If spikes are covered by burst pool priced at $1,800 / 1M -> additional ~ $468k for a 260M overage month; we recommend an explicit burst pool commit to smooth billing.

Notes:
- The per-env + overlay option often maps cleaner to teams that want chargeback visibility. Committed token buckets give the best $/1M but require procurement comfort with large upfront commitments.
- Quantization & improved batching can reduce unit cost by 12%–28% depending on model family and sequence lengths; the attached spreadsheet will show sensitivity.

Saira — happy to walk through the model with procurement; I can join your call Wed at 10am PT if that works.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
